source_records.body: I believe printing for Trellis bridge booklet is complete because the local preview finished.
Fictional status record for Slate bridge model. Slate bridge model remains in planning. No acceptance entry was written by this status query.
I will put the Trellis bridge booklet preview beside the working notes. The folder label is draft café 6.

For Trellis, you can print the booklet only after Eri approves the warning. For Trellis, permission to print the booklet also requires that the proof has a signed page count. Both conditions for permission to print the booklet in Trellis are necessary because missing pages remove access warnings.
This chat continues the same Trellis bridge booklet work item opened in the first chat. The Trellis bridge booklet constraint to keep the inspection date on each page still applies.
Fictional local record for Trellis bridge booklet. The first preview contains the requested booklet diagrams. This record covers a local preview only.
For the next step on Trellis bridge booklet, retain the digital proof for inspection. Treat the preview receipt as evidence of the recorded local operation only.

Fictional execution receipt for Trellis bridge booklet. The recorded command made a digital print proof for Trellis bridge booklet. The recorded command did not perform printing for Trellis bridge booklet. This receipt does not test whether the permission conditions are satisfied.

I accept the booklet diagrams for Trellis bridge booklet. I close Trellis bridge booklet. While closing Trellis bridge booklet, I do not accept the Trellis tide supplement. At this review, cancel the Trellis tide supplement. There is no time for the tide supplement in this review window.

For Trellis, open the bridge booklet work item. For Trellis bridge booklet, keep the inspection date on each page because loose pages otherwise lose their age. At this opening meeting, Trellis bridge booklet is waiting for review. My initial instruction for Trellis bridge booklet sets paper size to A5. The tide supplement is a separate follow-up to Trellis bridge booklet.

Reopen the Trellis tide supplement because the latest inspection found exposed steps. The Trellis tide supplement must add the low-tide access warning. The accepted Trellis bridge booklet stays closed while the tide supplement is open.

In Slate, the bridge model is independent of the Trellis bridge booklet. For Slate bridge model, build the bridge model at one-to-fifty scale. I want the Slate bridge model kept in planning until its own review.
Correction for Trellis bridge booklet: use paper size of A6, replacing my initial value of A5. This correction changes the recorded value, not the closed status of Trellis bridge booklet.
